note: October 30 HalfCheetah cohort, 1M training steps, 30 seeds (1-30), 20 episodes per condition. Gravity varies horizontal gx=-x m/s^2, nominal x=0, not downward gravity scale. KL is the physical-support radius operator, not the newer moment-bootstrap beta operator. Ordinary standard is fixed. Best-per-axis is descriptive ex-post full-grid selection, not held-out inference or physical-success evidence. No new rollout videos. Twelve localized mass/friction axes have identical per-policy returns at every level; perturbation effectiveness is unverified. Retained for completeness, not treated as evidence of shift tolerance.
statistic: Mean of policy-level episode means; +/-1 sample SD across 30 training seeds, not confidence intervals.

selection.rule: largest complete axis grid mean among active settings
